lines.text: Don't like it? No, I don't!
Many learners say: Don't you like tea? Yes, I don't.
Better: Don't you like tea? No, I don't.
Say no if you do not like it.

native.comment: Cevap: “No”. Sevmiyorsan cevap “no” olur. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.hook: Don't like it? Say “No, I don't.”
en.tip: If you do not like it, the answer is “No, I don't.”
en.caption: Do you say “Don't you like tea? Yes, I don't”? 😅 In English the answer is “no” when you do not like it, and it is never “yes” here. The right sentence is “Don't you like tea? No, I don't.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
